title: 4Sum
description:
[Source: LeetCode 18]
Given an array nums of n integers, return an array of all the unique quadruplets [nums[a], nums[b], nums[c], nums[d]] such that the sum is equal to target. Return the count of unique quadruplets.

Input Format:
First line: n target
Second line: n space-separated integers

Output Format:
Number of unique quadruplets
